name: Setozaki Yuma
source: Daughter of the academy headmaster and the protagonist's kouhai. She has no self confidence but wants to change that. She came to Tokyo from Hiroshima to attend the boarding school. Doesn't care much about her Hiroshima dialect and often blurts it out without trying to hide it.
